title: A Kitchen for the Letters
author: Ansel Eriksen
blurb: Astrid Underhill, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
